factRule: Creative facts (who a character is, story, role, costume, appearance) come only from this pack, the sources it names, or the Owner. Propose anything missing and wait for the Owner's yes before generating.

style.order: aesthetic block (verbatim) -> character rules -> the actor's stylization block -> identity -> look -> per-image items

fullPack.summary: Default actor identity pack: 55 PNG + 6 WAV + 1 sample video. A work order may add, drop or rename slots; slot keys come from ../src/content/asset-series.json.

images.expression: all 26 keys of the expression series
wardrobe-personal: +3 actor-specific extras named in the work order

fullPack.look: Every series except wardrobe-personal uses the casting-basics look; wardrobe-personal uses the actor's personal look.
fullPack.proportion: Full-body anchors are measured with MediaFactory .agents/skills/mf-actor-pack/references/proportion-review.md (skull crown, never the hair top).

naming.anchorVersionRule: v1 stays for single redraws; bump the whole set only when face.front or turnaround.front changes.

delivery.handoff: notes/handoffs/{date}-{slug}.md — one file per actor per order, updated in place; run logs stay in the MediaFactory run; move to notes/history/ when the order is done.
handoffMustList: new looks: id, bilingual label, English prompt, extra slot keys with bilingual labels, work and role
new characters or actors needing Owner decisions
delivery.publish: Done by a SwimmerParty-Website session, not by the producer: sync looks to src/content/actors/<slug>/looks.ts, copy files to assets-inbox/<code>/, run pnpm assets:ingest, release per docs/reference/release.md.

chatgpt-web.model: 5.6 Pro (GPT-5.6 Sol, thinking effort at max)
chatgpt-web.existingChats: routes.chatgpt-web.chat in each actor file. Older SP-03/SP-13 chats live in the ChatGPT project 'Claude'.
chatgpt-web.newCharacters: One chat per actor in Pics-A, reused for every batch of that actor. Upload the actor's anchors.face (and anchors.body once approved) first and say 'identity only'.
chatgpt-web.batch: Up to 10 separate PNGs per message for one actor and one approved identity (IMAGE 1 OF N ...). Unapproved identities: 2-3 candidates per message. Fill only missing or duplicate slots in the same chat.
